summary: Behavior change: the default local budget allows 10 model steps (was 6) and 60,000 input tokens per turn (was 40,000), so typical read-plus-planning requests that need 7 steps finish. Tool calls (8), time and cost limits are unchanged.
howTo: Nothing to do to get the new defaults. An app that relies on the old step or token limit (tests that expect a stop after 6 steps, cost estimates) sets them explicitly: createGlirastes({ localLimits: { maxModelSteps: 6, maxInputTokens: 40_000 } }); the runtime container sets limits.maxModelSteps and limits.maxInputTokens in its JSON configuration. The agent and policy revisions still cap the local values (the lowest wins). See docs/managed-runtime-sync.md, Budget denials.
